@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+# rewrite-flix
+
+OpenRewrite language support for [Flix](https://flix.dev) — a JVM-based functional
+language with first-class effects, traits, enums, and Datalog-style logic/fixpoint
+constructs.
+
+See [ADR 11](../doc/adr/0011-flix-language-module.md) for the design and the parser
+integration strategy.
+
+## Status
+
+Early phase. The module parses Flix source into a **lossless** `Flix.CompilationUnit`
+that retains the original source verbatim and prints it back byte-for-byte. Rich
+`Flix.*`/`J.*` LST nodes, type attribution, and recipes land in later phases.
+
+## Parser jars (not yet published)
+
+The parser reuses the Flix compiler front-end (`Lexer` + `Parser2`), decoupled from the
+`Flix` god-object on `wstein/flix-fork@feature/java2kotlin`, and shipped by
+[`java2kotlin-vendor-artifacts`](https://github.com/wstein/java2kotlin-vendor-artifacts).
+
+Because R8 strips Scala pickle signatures, the module **compiles** against the full Flix
+assembly (signatures intact) and **runs** against the slim, R8-shrunk parser jar:
+
+| File | Role | Source |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `libs/flix-full.jar` | `compileOnly` | full Flix assembly with the A1 decoupling |
+| `libs/flix-parser.jar` | `runtimeOnly` | slim, R8-shrunk front-end (backend removed) |
+
+Both are **git-ignored** and must be present for the module to build. Until the vendor
+release is published, place them in `libs/` (build them via the flix fork + the vendor
+`tools/shade` workflow). `settings.gradle.kts` includes `rewrite-flix` only when
+`libs/flix-full.jar` exists, so a checkout without the jars still builds the rest of the
+repository.
+
+Once the vendor release ships, `build.gradle.kts` should pin the published artifacts by
+vendor tag + SHA256 instead of the local files.

@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+plugins {
+    id("org.openrewrite.build.language-library")
+    id("org.openrewrite.build.moderne-source-available-license")
+    scala
+}
+
+dependencies {
+    api(project(":rewrite-java"))
+
+    // The Scala parser bridge compiles against the FULL Flix assembly because R8
+    // strips Scala pickle signatures from the slim jar, so scalac cannot compile
+    // against the slim jar (though already-compiled bytecode runs fine against it).
+    // At runtime only the slim, R8-shrunk front-end is on the classpath.
+    //   compile: full assembly (Scala signatures present)
+    //   runtime: slim flix-parser jar (backend removed; SpikeParse-verified to run)
+    // TODO: pin both to the published vendor artifacts once a release ships them.
+    compileOnly(files("libs/flix-full.jar"))
+    runtimeOnly(files("libs/flix-parser.jar"))
+    testRuntimeOnly(files("libs/flix-parser.jar"))
+
+    // Scala 2.13 for the parser bridge (matches the vendored front-end's Scala).
+    implementation("org.scala-lang:scala-library:2.13.18")
+    implementation("org.scala-lang:scala-compiler:2.13.18")
+
+    compileOnly(project(":rewrite-test"))
+    compileOnly("org.slf4j:slf4j-api:1.7.+")
+
+    api("io.micrometer:micrometer-core:1.9.+")
+    api("org.jetbrains:annotations:latest.release")
+    api("com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-annotations")
+
+    testImplementation(project(":rewrite-test"))
+    testImplementation(project(":rewrite-java-test"))
+    testImplementation("org.assertj:assertj-core:latest.release")
+    testImplementation("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-api")
+    testImplementation("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-params")
+    testRuntimeOnly("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-engine")
+    testRuntimeOnly(project(":rewrite-java-21"))
+}
+
+// Mixed Java/Scala: the Scala parser bridge is compiled first, then the Java LST
+// and parser compile against it. Mirrors rewrite-scala.
+sourceSets {
+    main {
+        scala {
+            srcDirs("src/main/scala")
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+tasks.named<ScalaCompile>("compileScala") {
+    source(sourceSets.main.get().java)
+    classpath = sourceSets.main.get().compileClasspath
+    // The vendored Flix parser jar targets Java 21 bytecode; the compiler JVM
+    // must be able to read it.
+    javaLauncher.set(javaToolchains.launcherFor {
+        languageVersion.set(JavaLanguageVersion.of(21))
+    })
+    options.compilerArgs.add("-parameters")
+}
+
+tasks.named<JavaCompile>("compileJava") {
+    dependsOn("compileScala")
+    exclude("**/*.java")
+}

+ * https://docs.moderne.io/licensing/moderne-source-available-license + *

+ * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software + * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS, + * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied. + * See the License for the specific language governing permissions and + * limitations under the License. + */ +package org.openrewrite.flix.internal + +import ca.uwaterloo.flix.language.ast.shared.{AvailableClasses, Input, SecurityContext, Source} +import ca.uwaterloo.flix.language.ast.{ChangeSet, ReadAst, SyntaxTree} +import ca.uwaterloo.flix.language.phase.{Lexer, Parser2} + +import java.nio.file.Paths +import java.{util => ju} +import scala.collection.immutable.Map + +/** + * Bridge to the vendored, decoupled Flix front-end. Runs the lexer and parser + * (which no longer require a `Flix` compiler instance) and reports diagnostics + * in a Java-friendly form. The full `SyntaxTree` -> LST mapping lands in a later + * phase; for now this validates that a source lexes and parses cleanly, which is + * enough for a lossless, print-equals-input `Flix.CompilationUnit`. + */ +object FlixParserBridge { + + /** Parse `source`, returning lexer + parser diagnostics (empty when clean). */ + def parse(path: String, source: String): ju.List[String] = { + val input = Input.VirtualFile(Paths.get(path), source, SecurityContext.Default) + val src = Source.fromString(input, source) + val root = ReadAst.Root(Map(src -> (())), AvailableClasses.empty) + + val (tokens, lexErrors) = Lexer.run(root, Map.empty, ChangeSet.Everything) + val (_, parseErrors) = Parser2.run(tokens, SyntaxTree.empty, ChangeSet.Everything) + + val diagnostics = new ju.ArrayList[String]() + lexErrors.foreach(e => diagnostics.add(e.toString)) + parseErrors.foreach(e => diagnostics.add(e.toString)) + diagnostics + } +}
